description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization IDs, including generating and decrypting organization IDs using AES encryption with a tenant-specific salt. It also includes a validation function for the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates a URL-encoded organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with a tenant-specific AES key.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts a URL-encoded organization ID back to the original email for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is valid (non-empty and properly formatted).
